description.html: HabiStat Arboreal Double Feeding Ledge lets arboreal species eat and drink up high, as they would in the wild. The ledge is made of black acrylic, while the cups and suction cups are clear, so you can see the contents from every angle without disturbing the animal. It measures 16 x 6 x 8 cm (length x depth x height).

Large weight-bearing suction cups hold the ledge on the glass wall of the terrarium, with no glue or drilling, and it is easy to move. The cups clip in place, come out easily, wash well and can be reused. The manufacturer also sells replacement cups separately.

The ledge is handy for crested geckos, day geckos and other arboreal species that rarely come down to the ground. A cup can hold fruit mix, insects or water. The double version has two cups side by side, so you can keep fruit mix or insects in one and water in the other. For tighter spaces there is also the single version with one cup.
Clean the glass before mounting so the suction cups hold well, and wash the cups whenever you change the food. See ready-made terrariums for arboreal species on our terrariums page.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
